notes.title: siMarket Supermarket Simulator 2.0 IS HERE!!!
notes.content:
siMarket 2.0 is Here!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050095/d091edd1b13e50ee45ff210bbbcaaf4d42292d59.png[/img]

We’re excited to announce the release of siMarket 2.0, packed with exciting new features and improvements to enhance your supermarket management experience!

New Features:

    🏙 Bigger City: Explore a more expansive city with new opportunities!
    🛒 Supermarket Expansion: Enjoy a larger supermarket space to accommodate more items and customers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050095/7fad0f1dc1129c80230efebc63a6a96796c73c4b.png[/img]

    🎨 Shop Customization: Paint your shop in any color of your choice!
    🚪 Adjustable Door Placement: Change the location of your shop's door to suit your layout.
    🏪 Shop Name Display: Give your shop a name and see it proudly displayed above the entrance.
    🚗 Item Delivery with Car: Watch as a car drives by when new items are delivered to your supermarket.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050095/3816f9eadc1c81ea6814aa613035db8d3ff6f4af.png[/img]

    🏦 Deposit System: Deposits are now possible for your growing business.
    🤖 AI Rework: Improved AI with more interesting and interactive movement for a livelier shopping experience.
    👷‍♂️ Restocker Worker: You can now hire a restocker to help manage your inventory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050095/f2d4c09e17754194cd21abf7181ecf72648e56d7.png[/img]

    📊 Shop Statistics & Tracking: Keep track of your store’s performance with detailed stats.
    💻 Store Items Displayed on PC: View your stock on the in-game PC.
    🌍 Localization: siMarket now supports multiple languages including German, French, Spanish, Japanese, Turkish, Italian, Portuguese, and English.



And many more small enhancements to improve your supermarket simulation experience!
